name: Linear
description: Project management: streamlined issue tracking and project planning tool for modern software teams.
access_notes: Anyone on a free Linear workspace can create a personal API key under Settings > Account > Security & Access; OAuth2 applications are created self-serve at linear.app/settings/api/applications/new. Workspace admins can restrict Member API key creation, but admins always can.
mcp_notes: Linear hosts an official remote MCP server at https://mcp.linear.app/mcp (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration; read-only variant at /mcp/readonly), documented at linear.app/docs/mcp and announced in the 2025-05-01 changelog. Composio also has a managed LINEAR toolkit (47 tools, 12 triggers, OAuth2 + API key auth).

evidence.note: Public API is GraphQL at api.linear.app/graphql; 'The Linear API supports personal API keys and OAuth2 authentication' — API key passed as Authorization header, OAuth tokens as Bearer.
OAuth2 authorization_code flow recommended for apps; also documents client_credentials grant for server-to-server. OAuth apps created self-serve in workspace settings.
Personal API keys created from Settings > Account > Security & Access; 'full support for mutating all entities'; webhooks and OAuth apps managed in Settings > Administration > API.
Official vendor-hosted remote MCP server at https://mcp.linear.app/mcp using OAuth 2.1; tools for finding, creating and updating issues, projects, comments.
Vendor changelog announcing the official Linear MCP server.
Composio managed LINEAR toolkit: OAuth2 + API_KEY auth, 47 tools, 12 triggers.
